name: PolyStrata
what: A fork of Strata (0.1.4x line) that serves a dozen more model families through its own in-place GGUF engine, strata-poly, with a hot-expert VRAM cache and the rest of the experts in RAM; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next still runs on Strata's own engine unchanged. One server per run config, as Strata, and since poly.7 a model switch while it runs (switch_on_request). Text only for the GLM and DeepSeek families.
licence: MIT (models and some parts under their own)

detect.data: PolyStrata-data next to the install folder, or data_dir in %APPDATA%\PolyStrata\settings.json (~/.config/polystrata/settings.json on Linux)

version.note: the engine's build file; /props says build_info "PolyStrata 0.1.45-poly.N" while a server is up

detect.note: a server's command line is python <root>/serve/server.py --engine strata --config strata-<model>.json, the same shape as Strata's: detection tells them apart by the install folder's name in that path.

can: everything the Strata driver does: start a unit from its launcher, load and unload through the API, see busy from /metrics, stop the process
park a unit that loads on any request
cannot: switch the loaded model inside one server (its /api/models/load): one Quartermaster unit is one run config, as with Strata; run one server per model, or switch by hand
vision for the GLM and DeepSeek families: the engine has none
drive.note: Verified against the server source (serve/server.py, 2026-11-07): /health carries `loaded`, /metrics carries the same `live` block the probe reads, and the control calls accept a request with no Origin header. Then driven on Windows 2026-11-07, PolyStrata 0.1.45-poly.8's server fronting the Strata project's 0.1.57 engine and a Strata-built Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q8_0 pack on a 32 GB card (the test machine had those; PolyStrata's own strata-poly engine and its model downloads were not exercised): detection from the run config and launcher, start from run-<model>.bat (211 s to loaded), the probe's engine block (context, kv, expert slots) and live state, unload through /v1/unload?wait=20 (200, card and RAM back in under 30 s), load through /v1/load (214 s), busy with tok/s during a generation, stop. The engine takes some seconds after its port closes to give its RAM back; the stop reports done when the port closes.

never: --host 0.0.0.0 without --api-key: the page has no login

update.note: Releases are tagged v0.1.45-poly.N (one most weeks). UPDATE.bat (update.sh) brings the checkout and the ready-made engine up to date; the check compares the engine's build to the newest release. The repository moved from VecSzn to simplexai-labs in 2026; a clone from the old name still pulls.

windows: Download the repository as a zip (or git clone https://github.com/simplexai-labs/PolyStrata) into PolyStrata, double-click START-HERE.bat: it fetches the ready-made engine for your card, asks which model family, downloads it to PolyStrata-data next to the folder, and writes strata-<model>.json and run-<model>.bat.
then: Change the port with --port when 8080 is taken (Docker Desktop and WSL relays often hold it on Windows).

good: the big MoE families Strata itself does not serve (GLM, DeepSeek V4, Kimi, MiniMax, Qwen3.6/3.7 and others), text only, with experts in RAM
a Strata owner who wants one more family without a second kind of server
not: vision on GLM or DeepSeek: use Maya or mainline llama.cpp
a model whose file exceeds RAM: it collapses to a few tokens a second
